gates.invariant: At most one active feed row owns an exact event_key + event_series_slot identity.
Only structured exact same-stage coverage may retire an event task; legacy title evidence is advisory.
A repeated unchanged dispatch observation should not spend another model cold-start when no capacity exists.
One task identity may not own two active worktrees or divergent delivery paths.
Aged scheduled work receives a bounded dispatch seat without suppressing urgent, time-critical, or collision-free alternatives.
PHASE-Z may commit only bytes proven to have appeared after the same fire generation baseline.
A PHASE-Z candidate may reach git commit only after the trusted pre-commit auditor proves that its exact candidate bytes introduce no new silent fallback.
A worktree with unmerged bytes or an unresolved push-backup hold cannot be reclaimed until one explicit merge/discard adjudication owns the artifact.
A worker process and its claimed task must have one live supervisor owner before orphan cleanup or redispatch may cut either edge.
Generation-time topic screening may suppress only a canonical exact duplicate; fuzzy similarity remains advisory.
Rhythm-controlled content respects a bounded minimum interval without starving time-sensitive or exempt publication edges.

gates.invariant: Reader-facing prose quality checks apply only the correct content-mode contract and cannot structurally reject required formats.
incident_refs: docs/error_log.md 2026-07-16 anti-AI FB mode blocked feed digest

gates.invariant: Reader-facing release eligibility applies the canonical audience/content contract and every hold is durably attributable to one article.

A general-reader article reaches the feed through either the immediate-publish or draft-release entry only after a lazy-pack heading with at least one Markdown image is installed; every hold remains attributable to one article.
A member question owns at most one reader-visible answer unless every prior answer is explicitly superseded or the missing binding is formally waived.
Release-pool overlap may hold only evidence-backed exact coverage and must preserve a recoverable downstream publication path.
Similarity across distinct event-series stages remains advisory and cannot suppress a later information state.
incident_refs: docs/error_log.md event T-2/T+0/T+1 coverage and cross-stage dedup incidents

gates.invariant: One exact non-event title may own at most one live publication inside the 24-hour identity window.
Reader-facing depth thresholds reject only content classes whose canonical length or evidence-table floor is unmet.
A Taipei calendar date may expose at most one live daily digest.
Daily-digest archive-span heuristics may hold only a recap-shaped draft while preserving explicit batch-migration warning evidence.
All fuzzy narrative and same-reference similarity signals are advisory review evidence and never own a publication lock.
One canonical K-id and audience pair owns at most one live article unless a distinct audience or explicit waiver is recorded.
Topic concentration caps preserve portfolio diversity without silently starving time-sensitive publication classes.

gates.invariant: Every event article carries event_key, event_type, event_date, and event_series_slot before it enters the event publication graph.
Every cited statistic in an audited article is present in its declared canonical experiment result before the article enters the feed.
Every embedded article image uses a canonical reader-served URL before the article enters the feed.
Every cited chart generated with CJK labels establishes a readable CJK font before the article enters the feed.
